newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY,NORWAY BOTH KEEP WORLD CUP HOPES WITH DRAW.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY,NORWAY BOTH KEEP WORLD CUP HOPES WITH DRAW.

text.p: Hungary and Norway fought out a keenly-fought 1-1 draw in their World Cup European zone group three qualifier in Budapest's Peoples' Stadium on Sunday.

In an exciting first half Norway went ahead in the eighth minute when Hungarian goalkeeper Gabor Babos could ony palm out a long free kick by Henning Berg to Petter Rudi, who volleyed the rebound in between two Hungarian defenders.
Hungary came back strongly and equalised when Zoltan Kovacs latched on to a delicate chip over the Norwegian defence by defender Emil Lorincz to shoot powerfully past Frode Grodaas.
The frenetic pace subsided in the second half, although Frank Strandl and Petter Rudi for Norway and Zoltan Kovacs for Hungary all went close.
The result keeps both teams in the running for World Cup qualification with Norway maintaining their four-point lead in the group and Hungary moving ahead of Switzerland into second place.
